correctness.rationale: For d>=3 the sign product is exactly the deck class of the projective shortest-geodesic polygon. Hilbert--Schmidt kernel trace and Funk--Hecke spherical harmonic expansion give the complete probability. The Sturm--Liouville boundary identity and explicit Gegenbauer coefficient yield the signed eigenvalue ratio; Parseval and strict spectral gaps prove the finite-length inequality and sharp two-mode expansion. Independent numerical integration, six direct Gaussian polygon simulations totalling 330000 draws, and separate spectral checks corroborate, not certify, the proof.

value.rationale: This computes a natural two-parameter topological probability for random geodesic cycles on every round real projective space of dimension at least two, beyond a previously known single triangle case. Sharp exponential decay with precise multiplicity, explicit finite-m error, and alternating next eigenmode give structural loop-mixing information that neither the classical isolated triangle computation nor an unevaluated general harmonic transform supplies. Applicable as exact benchmark for random geodesic loop topology; no external downstream theorem is required.
